summary:
Actutio is a decentralized performance analytical platform.

Actutio merges the version‑controlled collaboration of GitHub, the community‑driven discussion of Reddit and the rigorous mathematical processing of a data science environment.

Actutio was designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Actutio bridges the gap, between chaotic Earth observation data and actionable mathematically proven local insights.
details: Actutio is a collaborative Earth system analytics platform that merges the reproducibility of GitHub, the peer-reviewed discovery model of Reddit, and the rigor of a scientific modeling suite to separate mathematically proven climate signals from seasonal noise. Powered by a hybrid Python 3.13 and compiled C++ backend, Actutio ingests and caches multi-decade NASA open datasets—including NASA POWER 2-meter air temperature, GIBS/Worldview cloud overlays, Blue Marble surface imagery, and EONET natural hazard feeds—alongside Natural Earth regional boundaries on an interactive 3D globe. Rather than relying on visual guesswork from raw graphs, the engine decomposes time-series data into anomalies, long-term trends, quarterly seasonal slopes, spectral cycles, regime change-points, and statistical significance, while offering plain-language synthesis when AI: Active is enabled. By uniting custom Code, Simulation, and Workspace environments with a public Forum, a reusable detector Store, and one-click Aligned CSV and Share URL exports, Actutio saves researchers weeks of manual data wrangling and empowers students, citizen scientists, and local communities to uncover and share verified regional environmental trends worldwide. In compliance with NASA Space Apps Challenge transparency guidelines, AI tools were utilized to assist with UI design, code optimization, and learning two unfamiliar programming languages and a novel Python workflow, with all scientific formulas, statistical tests, and data pipelines independently validated by Team Entelerix.
